source_text: Charaka Samhita, Chikitsa Sthana, Chapter 1 (Rasayana Adhyaya)
traditional_indication: Nidrajanana, Balya, Medhya Rasayana (Promotes sleep and cognitive revitalization)
traditional_processing: Aqueous decoction (Kwatha) boiled with cow's milk (Ksheerapaka)
relevance_under_sec3p: Demonstrates prior traditional use of Ashwagandha + Brahmi for calming and sleep enhancement. Patent claims lacking surprising synergy are non-patentable under Section 3(p).
Established classical prior art for anti-inflammatory and antiseptic topical formulations.
